description: Bundled neon tube bank: five curl-perturbed sinusoidal tubes are shaded with a gaussian core, Fresnel rim and outer bloom, and each owns one FFT bin driving its thickness, hue drift and the gaussian light packets running along it. The pointer is a magnetic attractor that bends the bundle, clicks inject bounded pulse fronts that flare the tubes they cross, and dataTextureC supplies exact-load afterglow.
name: Neon Pulse Stream
